title: Suhyup Bank confirms leak of personal information of 54 customers, inews24 reports
date_note: inews24 (published 27 November) says the bank confirmed the leak the day before.
geo_basis: country; the source does not state the headquarters city
summary: inews24 reports that Suhyup Bank confirmed the leak of personal information of 54 customers and reported it to the Financial Supervisory Service. The article says the data includes loan information, credit information and addresses. The bank says it is analysing access records to identify the path and cause.
plain: Suhyup Bank confirmed that personal information of 54 customers leaked, including loan and credit information, and reported it to the financial regulator. The cause is still being investigated.
exec: Suhyup Bank confirmed a leak of personal information of 54 customers; the cause is under investigation.

evidence.quote: 27일 금융권에 따르면 수협은행은 전날 고객 54명의 개인정보 유출 사실을 확인하고 금융감독원에 보고했다.

validation.note: Only inews24 was read; the bank's own notice was not read.
